seed299.training_diagnostic_scope: All 168 hours of historical training cases; sampled_training uses the fitted stride4 subset. In-sample scores with overlapping weeks are optimistic.
seed299.sampling_rule: Full weekly inputs, then hour % stride == (Run No + seed) % stride; all evaluation hours retained.
seed299.note: Training scores are supplied diagnostics, not independent validation; no models are replayed here.

limitations: Historical years are reused development data. No blend weights or features are selected here. Frozen2022 and native2022 share labels. Jan7+ removes six starts overlapping2021 selection horizons. When enabled, bootstrap uses200 paired draws of circular14-day blocks of whole cases, conditional on supplied predictions; it does not correct model-selection bias. Generator AUCs are diagnostics; selection metric is pooled micro AUC.
